cohort: 145 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) cases managed at a single tertiary center between May 2015 and December 2024.
finding: An algorithm incorporating cervical length and antepartum bleeding history may assist in individualizing delivery timing for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) cases within 34 to 35+6 weeks' gestation, with urgent delivery linked to increased maternal and neonatal morbidity.
gest_age: 34 to 35+6 weeks of gestation (target window for delivery timing)
